title: Lichess Tournament Round Centipawn Loss Leaderboard
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lichess:tournament centipawn_loss=*
| stats sum(centipawn_loss) as total_value, avg(centipawn_loss) as avg_value by opening_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks opening name values by total and average centipawn loss across Lichess tournament round events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `centipawn_loss` values for each Lichess tournament round event and review total and average centipawn loss by opening name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total centipawn loss.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which opening name shows the biggest centipawn loss numbers in your Lichess tournament round data.
